name: Expressions
description: Safe arithmetic expression evaluation for calculators and derived values.

operations.name: expr.evaluate
operations.description: Evaluates an arithmetic expression string and returns its numeric value.

inputs.name: expression
inputs.description: Arithmetic expression: + - * / % ^, parentheses, unary minus, sqrt/abs/floor/ceil/round, two-argument min/max/pow, the constants pi and e, and any bound variables

inputs.name: var.<name>
inputs.description: One input per variable used in the expression; numeric strings from inputs coerce automatically

operations.howto: Calculator pattern: bind expression from an input element and wire the operation to a button click; route the value output to a state key shown by a text element. Multi-field math: put the formula in a constant expression and bind each variable with a var.<name> input, e.g. expression "w / (h ^ 2)" with var.w and var.h from two inputs (no parseNumber needed; numeric strings coerce). Everything runs locally; a malformed expression, division by zero, or unknown variable is an error.
